fullDescription: A strictly monochrome button system in graphite and platinum on warm paper: five variants (solid, outline, soft, ghost, link), three sizes, and every state (hover, focus, loading, disabled) drawn on hairline borders with no accent color, framed as a real documentation page.
prompt:
## Resumo
A quiet, monochrome button-system showcase page rendered entirely in graphite and platinum on warm paper, framed as a real documentation site. A blurred sticky paper nav (a black rounded 'G' logo tile, a 'Graphite' wordmark with a 'v1.0' pill, five anchor links, a ghost 'Source' button and a solid 'Copy system' button) sits over a hero with a small dotted-grid + fade background, an eyebrow pill ('Button system · monochrome'), a huge bold 'Every button, / one calm grammar.' headline, a graphite subhead, a solid + outline CTA pair, and a row of check-marked feature notes. The body is a two-column layout: a sticky left index ('On this page' with dot bullets) and a main column of bordered card sections, Variants (a 5-cell divided grid: Solid, Outline, Soft, Ghost, Link, each captioned with its emphasis level), Sizes (sm/md/lg in both solid and outline), States (a horizontally scrollable matrix of default/hover/focus/loading/disabled across Solid, Outline, Soft), With icons (leading/trailing/icon-only square buttons plus a segmented group), and Tokens (a graphite-ramp swatch list beside a dark code panel of button.css). It closes on a full-bleed dark graphite CTA strip (an inverted white 'Copy CSS' button + a bordered 'Read the docs' button) and a minimal paper footer.

## Estilo Visual
Build a calm, fully MONOCHROME UI. No accent color at all, only a graphite grayscale ramp on warm paper. Define the palette exactly: graphite-900 #1c1c1e, graphite-800 #222224, graphite-700 #2c2c2e, graphite-600 #3a3a3c, graphite-500 #48484a, graphite-400 #636366, graphite-300 #8e8e93, platinum #c7c7cc, paper #f6f6f4 (page bg), card #fcfcfb (slightly brighter card fill), plus pure #fff and #000 for the solid button. Borders are HAIRLINES: a normal hairline = 1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.10) and a hairline-strong = 1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.16); use them on the nav, every card, dividers and swatches. Fonts via Google Fonts: Inter (weights 400,450,500,600,700) for all UI and headlines, and JetBrains Mono (400,500) used ONLY for tiny uppercase caption labels and the code panel. Set body letter-spacing -0.011em with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased and text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; headlines use a 'tightest' tracking of -0.03em; buttons use -0.006em. Radius scale is small and consistent: buttons 9px (sm 7px, lg 11px), logo tile 7px, cards/pills larger (rounded-xl/full). Transitions are gentle: .18s ease on background/border/color/box-shadow and .12s on transform; on :active nudge translateY(0.5px). Focus is a soft ring: box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,199,204,0.55). Add a faint dotted grid utility for the hero only: two crossing linear-gradients of rgba(28,28,30,0.035) 1px lines on a 28px tile, with a paper gradient fading from transparent to solid over it. Keep everything quiet, whitespace-heavy and value-driven, the entire 'design language' is hierarchy without hue.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky blurred nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) on translucent paper (bg-paper/80) with a saturate(180%) blur(14px) backdrop-filter and a bottom hairline border. Inside a max-w-[1180px] row, h-16, justified between: LEFT = a brand cluster, a 28px (h-7 w-7) rounded-[7px] graphite-900 tile holding a bold white 'G' (tightest tracking), then a 15px semibold 'Graphite' wordmark, then a small 'v1.0' pill (11px medium graphite-300, hairline border, rounded-full, hidden on mobile); CENTER (hidden below md, gap-7) = five 13.5px medium graphite-400 anchor links 'Variants / Sizes / States / Icons / Tokens' that darken to graphite-900 on hover; RIGHT (gap-2.5) = a ghost small button 'Source' with a leading lucide:github icon (hidden on mobile) and a solid small button 'Copy system' with a trailing lucide:arrow-right.

### Hero
A bordered-bottom section with a faint dotted-grid background and a paper gradient fade over it (from-paper/0 via-paper/40 to-paper). In a relative max-w-[1180px] column, pt-20 pb-16 -> lg:pt-28 lg:pb-20, a max-w-3xl block: an eyebrow pill (inline-flex, rounded-full, hairline border, bg-card, px-3 py-1) with a tiny 1.5px graphite-900 dot + 12px medium graphite-400 label 'Button system · monochrome'; then a bold 'tightest'-tracked h1 at 44px -> 58px -> 66px, leading 1.04, reading 'Every button,' / 'one calm grammar.' (line break only on sm+); a 17 -> 18px relaxed graphite-500 subhead (max-w-xl) 'A restrained, monochrome button system in graphite and platinum. Five variants, three sizes, every state, drawn on hairlines so the interface stays quiet and the action stays obvious.'; a CTA pair (gap-3, flex-wrap), a solid LG button 'Browse the grid' with a trailing lucide:layout-grid and an outline LG button 'View tokens' with a leading lucide:code; and a wrapped feature row (mt-12, 12.5px medium graphite-300, gap-x-8) of four lucide:check + label items '5 variants', '3 sizes', 'Hover · focus · active · loading · disabled', 'WCAG-AA contrast'.

### Showcase body shell + sticky left index
A max-w-[1180px] section, py-16 -> lg:py-20, laid out on lg as a grid-cols-[200px_1fr] with gap-14 (single column below lg). LEFT (hidden below lg) = a sticky (top-24) index: a JetBrains-Mono uppercase 10px tracked caption 'On this page', then a vertical nav of five 13.5px links, the active one (Variants) is graphite-900 medium on a card fill with a hairline border and a 1px graphite-900 dot, the rest are graphite-400 with platinum dots that darken on hover; below it a small card (rounded-lg, hairline, bg-card, p-4) with a 12px graphite-400 note 'Built on a single radius scale and a graphite ramp. No color, just hierarchy.'. RIGHT = the main column (min-w-0) holding the five sections, each spaced mt-16.

### Section header pattern
Every showcase section opens with the same header: a flex items-baseline justified-between row with a bottom hairline border, pb-3 mb-7, a 24 -> 27px semibold tight-tracked h2 (Variants / Sizes / States / With icons / Tokens) on the left and a JetBrains-Mono uppercase 10px graphite-300 'state-cap' on the right ('5 levels of emphasis' / 'sm · md · lg' / 'interaction matrix' / 'leading · trailing · icon-only' / 'copy & paste'). Most sections then add a 15px relaxed graphite-500 intro paragraph (max-w-2xl, mb-8) before the demo card.

### Variants card
A rounded-xl hairline card with bg-card and overflow-hidden, containing a responsive grid (grid-cols-2 -> sm:3 -> lg:5) with hairline divide-x/divide-y borders. Five centered cells (flex-col items-center, gap-4, py-9), each a medium button plus a Mono caption beneath: Solid button + 'Primary', Outline button + 'Secondary', Soft button + 'Tertiary', Ghost button + 'Quiet', and a Link-style button (underlined text via a bottom-border span) + 'Inline'. This demonstrates emphasis falling off from solid graphite down to a plain inline link with zero hue.

### Sizes card
A rounded-xl hairline bg-card card, p-8 -> sm:p-10, with a flex-wrap items-end row (gap-x-9 gap-y-8): three solid buttons Small/Medium/Large each above a Mono caption of its type/padding spec ('12.5 / 7x13', '13.5 / 9x16', '15 / 12x20'), then a thin vertical graphite divider (h-12 w-px bg-graphite-900/10, hidden on mobile), then the same three sizes as outline buttons captioned 'outline'. Shows the shared type-and-radius ramp across density.

### States matrix card
A rounded-xl hairline bg-card card with overflow-x-auto wrapping a min-w-[640px] table built from CSS grid. A header row (grid-cols-[88px_1fr_1fr_1fr_1fr_1fr], faint graphite/2% tint, bottom hairline) of Mono caption cells: 'variant', then centered 'default / hover / focus / loading / disabled'. Then three data rows (Solid, Outline, Soft), each a 6-column grid with the variant name (12.5px graphite-400) and five small buttons demonstrating: default, a hover-styled instance (forced hover background/border), a focus instance carrying an always-on platinum focus ring, a loading instance with a spinning ring + 'Saving', and a disabled (is-disabled, .42 opacity) instance. Rows separated by bottom hairlines.

### With-icons card
A rounded-xl hairline bg-card card, p-8 -> sm:p-10, flex-wrap items-center (gap-x-7 gap-y-7): four labelled icon buttons across the variants (solid 'New file' + leading lucide:plus, outline 'Continue' + trailing lucide:arrow-right, soft 'Export' + leading lucide:download, ghost 'Share' + leading lucide:share-2); a thin vertical divider; three SQUARE icon-only buttons (38x38, padding 9px) outline lucide:settings / soft lucide:bookmark / solid lucide:search, each aria-labelled; another divider; then a SEGMENTED group, an inline-flex rounded-[9px] hairline-strong overflow-hidden bar of three rounded-none buttons (Left filled graphite with a white-ish right divider, Center and Right as quiet graphite-600 text with hairline dividers).

### Tokens section
A grid sm:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr] gap-5. LEFT = a rounded-xl hairline bg-card swatch panel (p-6) with a Mono caption 'Graphite ramp' and five rows, each a 32px rounded-md hairline color chip + a Mono 12px hex (graphite-500) + a right-aligned graphite-300 token name: #1c1c1e graphite/900, #2c2c2e graphite/700, #636366 graphite/400, #c7c7cc platinum, #f6f6f4 paper. RIGHT = a dark code panel, rounded-xl hairline, bg-graphite-900, p-6, overflow-x-auto, with a top row (a Mono 'button.css' caption in graphite-300 + a lucide:clipboard icon in platinum) over a JetBrains-Mono 12px <pre> block of platinum/90 CSS showing .btn-solid { background:#1c1c1e; color:#fff; border-radius:9px; padding:9px 16px } and .btn:focus-visible box-shadow with selectors dimmed to graphite-300 and values highlighted in white/platinum.

### Dark CTA strip
A full-bleed section with a top hairline border, bg-graphite-900, white text. In a max-w-[1180px] column (py-16 -> lg:py-20) a flex that stacks on mobile / row+justified-between on lg: LEFT (max-w-xl) a 28 -> 34px semibold tightest-tracked white h2 'Drop the whole system into your project.' over a 15.5px platinum/80 line 'Five variants, three sizes, every state, one stylesheet. No dependencies, no color decisions to make.'; RIGHT a gap-3 flex-wrap button pair, an INVERTED solid LG button (bg #fff, text graphite-900) 'Copy CSS' with a leading lucide:clipboard-copy, and an outline-on-dark LG button (transparent, white text, white/25 border) 'Read the docs' with a trailing lucide:arrow-up-right.

### Footer
A minimal paper footer with a top hairline, max-w-[1180px], py-9, a flex that stacks on mobile / row+justified-between on sm: LEFT a brand cluster (a 24px rounded-[6px] graphite-900 'G' tile + a 13px medium graphite-400 'Graphite Button System'); RIGHT a gap-6 row of three quiet 12.5px graphite-300 links 'Components / Tokens / Changelog' (darken on hover) and a 'copyright 2026' note.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
One base .btn (inline-flex, items/justify-center, gap 0.45em, border 1px solid transparent, radius 9px, Inter 500, letter-spacing -0.006em, line-height 1, white-space nowrap, gentle .18s transitions, :active translateY(0.5px)) plus FIVE variants that descend in emphasis with NO color: .btn-solid (bg #1c1c1e, white text; hover #000; active #2c2c2e), .btn-outline (transparent, graphite-900 text, border rgba(28,28,30,0.22); hover bg rgba(28,28,30,0.04) + border .40; active bg .07), .btn-soft (bg rgba(28,28,30,0.06), graphite-900 text; hover .10; active .13), .btn-ghost (transparent, graphite-600 text; hover bg rgba(28,28,30,0.05) + graphite-900 text), and .btn-link (transparent, graphite-900 text, an inner span.u with a 1px bottom border rgba(28,28,30,0.30) that goes solid graphite on hover). The whole emphasis hierarchy is built from value and fill opacity alone.

### Componente
A single matched size scale: .btn-sm = font 12.5px, padding 7px 13px, radius 7px; .btn-md = font 13.5px, padding 9px 16px, radius 9px; .btn-lg = font 15px, padding 12px 20px, radius 11px. Type size and radius scale together so the button shape stays proportional at every density.

### Componente
Accessible focus without color: on :focus-visible remove the outline and draw box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,199,204,0.55) (a soft platinum halo). Provide a demo-only .btn-focus class (same ring at 0.65 alpha) so the focus state can be shown statically in the states matrix.

### Componente
An in-button spinner: a 13px circle, 2px solid currentColor border with a transparent right edge, border-radius 50%, opacity .9, animated spin .7s linear infinite (transform rotate(360deg)). It inherits the button's text color (so it is white on solid, graphite on outline/soft) and sits before a 'Saving' label.

### Componente
A single dimmed disabled treatment: opacity .42, cursor not-allowed, pointer-events none, applied via [disabled] or an .is-disabled class so any variant reads as disabled instantly without changing its hue.

### Componente
Tiny engineered labels used everywhere (section captions, cell captions, swatch names, code-panel header): .state-cap = JetBrains Mono, 10px, letter-spacing 0.06em, uppercase, color graphite-300. They are the only place the mono font appears outside the code block and give the page its 'spec sheet' feel.

### Componente
Square icon-only buttons: a .btn with fixed 38x38 and 9px padding holding a single 16px Iconify lucide icon (settings/bookmark/search), aria-labelled, in any variant. Segmented group: an inline-flex rounded-[9px] hairline-strong overflow-hidden bar of rounded-none .btn segments sharing 1px inner dividers (white/12% inside the filled segment, rgba black/12% between quiet segments), the first filled graphite, the rest quiet graphite-600 text.

### Componente
A faint engineering grid behind the hero only: two crossing linear-gradients of rgba(28,28,30,0.035) 1px lines on a 28px 28px tile (.grid-bg), placed as an absolute pointer-events-none layer, with a second absolute paper gradient (from-paper/0 via-paper/40 to-paper) fading it out toward the content so it never competes with the headline.

## Notas Especiais
STRICTLY monochrome, there is no accent hue anywhere; all emphasis comes from a graphite-to-platinum value ramp on warm paper drawn with sub-16% black hairline borders. Exact palette: graphite-900 #1c1c1e, 800 #222224, 700 #2c2c2e, 600 #3a3a3c, 500 #48484a, 400 #636366, 300 #8e8e93, platinum #c7c7cc, paper #f6f6f4 (page bg), card #fcfcfb (card fill); solid button uses #1c1c1e -> hover #000 -> active #2c2c2e with #fff text. Hairlines: rgba(28,28,30,0.10), strong rgba(28,28,30,0.16). Focus ring: rgba(199,199,204,0.55). Fonts via Google Fonts: Inter (400/450/500/600/700) for everything, JetBrains Mono (400/500) ONLY for the .state-cap labels and the code panel. Negative letter-spacing throughout (body -0.011em, headlines -0.03em, buttons -0.006em). Icons are Iconify lucide loaded from code.iconify.design (github, arrow-right, layout-grid, code, check, plus, download, share-2, settings, bookmark, search, clipboard, clipboard-copy, arrow-up-right). Radius scale 7/9/11px on buttons. To transfer the STYLE, keep the no-color graphite ramp + hairlines + Inter/Mono pairing + soft platinum focus ring + gentle 180ms transitions and the .42 disabled / spinner conventions. To transfer the LAYOUT, keep the framed doc page (sticky blurred nav -> dotted-grid hero -> sticky-index two-column body of bordered Variants/Sizes/States/Icons/Tokens cards -> dark CTA strip -> minimal footer) and the repeated section-header + Mono state-cap pattern. No em-dashes in any copy.

No dependencies, no color decisions to make.'; RIGHT a gap-3 flex-wrap button pair, an INVERTED solid LG button (bg #fff, text graphite-900) 'Copy CSS' with a leading lucide:clipboard-copy, and an outline-on-dark LG button (transparent, white text, white/25 border) 'Read the docs' with a trailing lucide:arrow-up-right.

A minimal paper footer with a top hairline, max-w-[1180px], py-9, a flex that stacks on mobile / row+justified-between on sm: LEFT a brand cluster (a 24px rounded-[6px] graphite-900 'G' tile + a 13px medium graphite-400 'Graphite Button System'); RIGHT a gap-6 row of three quiet 12.5px graphite-300 links 'Components / Tokens / Changelog' (darken on hover) and a 'copyright 2026' note.

special_ui_components.prompt: One base .btn (inline-flex, items/justify-center, gap 0.45em, border 1px solid transparent, radius 9px, Inter 500, letter-spacing -0.006em, line-height 1, white-space nowrap, gentle .18s transitions, :active translateY(0.5px)) plus FIVE variants that descend in emphasis with NO color: .btn-solid (bg #1c1c1e, white text; hover #000; active #2c2c2e), .btn-outline (transparent, graphite-900 text, border rgba(28,28,30,0.22); hover bg rgba(28,28,30,0.04) + border .40; active bg .07), .btn-soft (bg rgba(28,28,30,0.06), graphite-900 text; hover .10; active .13), .btn-ghost (transparent, graphite-600 text; hover bg rgba(28,28,30,0.05) + graphite-900 text), and .btn-link (transparent, graphite-900 text, an inner span.u with a 1px bottom border rgba(28,28,30,0.30) that goes solid graphite on hover). The whole emphasis hierarchy is built from value and fill opacity alone.

A single matched size scale: .btn-sm = font 12.5px, padding 7px 13px, radius 7px; .btn-md = font 13.5px, padding 9px 16px, radius 9px; .btn-lg = font 15px, padding 12px 20px, radius 11px. Type size and radius scale together so the button shape stays proportional at every density.

Accessible focus without color: on :focus-visible remove the outline and draw box-shadow 0 0 0 3px rgba(199,199,204,0.55) (a soft platinum halo). Provide a demo-only .btn-focus class (same ring at 0.65 alpha) so the focus state can be shown statically in the states matrix.

An in-button spinner: a 13px circle, 2px solid currentColor border with a transparent right edge, border-radius 50%, opacity .9, animated spin .7s linear infinite (transform rotate(360deg)). It inherits the button's text color (so it is white on solid, graphite on outline/soft) and sits before a 'Saving' label.

A single dimmed disabled treatment: opacity .42, cursor not-allowed, pointer-events none, applied via [disabled] or an .is-disabled class so any variant reads as disabled instantly without changing its hue.

Tiny engineered labels used everywhere (section captions, cell captions, swatch names, code-panel header): .state-cap = JetBrains Mono, 10px, letter-spacing 0.06em, uppercase, color graphite-300. They are the only place the mono font appears outside the code block and give the page its 'spec sheet' feel.

Square icon-only buttons: a .btn with fixed 38x38 and 9px padding holding a single 16px Iconify lucide icon (settings/bookmark/search), aria-labelled, in any variant. Segmented group: an inline-flex rounded-[9px] hairline-strong overflow-hidden bar of rounded-none .btn segments sharing 1px inner dividers (white/12% inside the filled segment, rgba black/12% between quiet segments), the first filled graphite, the rest quiet graphite-600 text.

A faint engineering grid behind the hero only: two crossing linear-gradients of rgba(28,28,30,0.035) 1px lines on a 28px 28px tile (.grid-bg), placed as an absolute pointer-events-none layer, with a second absolute paper gradient (from-paper/0 via-paper/40 to-paper) fading it out toward the content so it never competes with the headline.

structured.special_notes: STRICTLY monochrome, there is no accent hue anywhere; all emphasis comes from a graphite-to-platinum value ramp on warm paper drawn with sub-16% black hairline borders. Exact palette: graphite-900 #1c1c1e, 800 #222224, 700 #2c2c2e, 600 #3a3a3c, 500 #48484a, 400 #636366, 300 #8e8e93, platinum #c7c7cc, paper #f6f6f4 (page bg), card #fcfcfb (card fill); solid button uses #1c1c1e -> hover #000 -> active #2c2c2e with #fff text. Hairlines: rgba(28,28,30,0.10), strong rgba(28,28,30,0.16). Focus ring: rgba(199,199,204,0.55). Fonts via Google Fonts: Inter (400/450/500/600/700) for everything, JetBrains Mono (400/500) ONLY for the .state-cap labels and the code panel. Negative letter-spacing throughout (body -0.011em, headlines -0.03em, buttons -0.006em). Icons are Iconify lucide loaded from code.iconify.design (github, arrow-right, layout-grid, code, check, plus, download, share-2, settings, bookmark, search, clipboard, clipboard-copy, arrow-up-right). Radius scale 7/9/11px on buttons. To transfer the STYLE, keep the no-color graphite ramp + hairlines + Inter/Mono pairing + soft platinum focus ring + gentle 180ms transitions and the .42 disabled / spinner conventions. To transfer the LAYOUT, keep the framed doc page (sticky blurred nav -> dotted-grid hero -> sticky-index two-column body of bordered Variants/Sizes/States/Icons/Tokens cards -> dark CTA strip -> minimal footer) and the repeated section-header + Mono state-cap pattern. No em-dashes in any copy.
